label: Tweets
summary: Tweets and social media mentions about the product.

items.label: @devjane: love it but dark mode pls

data.author: @devjane
data.text: Just switched to @YourProduct for project management and WOW the analytics are incredible. But please, for the love of my retinas, add dark mode 🙏 #UX

data.author: @startup_mike
data.text: Anyone else having issues with @YourProduct exports? Tried to pull a report for investors and it just... never finishes. CSV export has been broken for a week now.

data.author: @pm_sarah
data.text: Compared @YourProduct vs @Competitor for our team. YourProduct wins on features but the onboarding is painful. Took us 3 days to get set up vs 30 min with Competitor. Once you're past that though, no contest.

data.author: @enterprise_cto
data.text: Love @YourProduct for small teams but hitting walls at enterprise scale. Rate limits, no SCIM, manual user management. The product itself is brilliant — the enterprise wrapper needs work.

data.author: @design_lead
data.text: The new @YourProduct dashboard redesign is 🔥 but the mobile app is a different story. Crashed 3 times during a client meeting today. Android issues are real.

data.author: @analyst_raj
data.text: Built a full data pipeline with @YourProduct API in a weekend. Clean docs, predictable responses. Only gripe: rate limits are aggressive for production use. 100 req/min won't cut it.
